rationale: Price touched the session low of $137.47 and immediately reversed to $137.48 on a massive volume spike (123k shares vs ~8k average), signaling strong bid absorption and a failure of the breakdown thesis. The surge in volume at the low suggests selling exhaustion and increases the probability of a mean-reversion bounce toward the 9-EMA ($137.63) or VWAP ($138.65). Closing secures the small profit and mitigates the risk of a sharp reversal in the final hour.
